decisions.reason: As a medium-sized German textile producer, we have strong related know-how in upholstery fabrics, and the dedicated product page suggests enough strategic importance and learning potential to continue refining it.

This decorative fabric is close to our existing weaving and furnishing-textile capabilities, so despite the weaker website signal we would usually keep it on the market long enough to learn from customer response.

The combination of curtain fabric, jacquard design and flame-retardant functionality fits deeply with established textile competences and offers clear scope for cumulative improvement, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn.

Although related to our decorative-textile base, the limited prominence and likely narrower premium niche make this a candidate to discontinue if early demand does not justify further development effort.

This fabric remains technologically related to our core knowledge, but its complex niche positioning and only modest market signal make it more likely that we would reallocate resources to stronger lines or new projects.
